feat.name: Bolt Adept
entries: You have drilled with the {@item test bow|TB1} until it is second nature:

items: You ignore the loading property of bows you are proficient with.
Once on each of your turns, you can reroll a {@damage 1d4} of bow damage.

feat.name: Lucky Hand
entries: Once per long rest, you can turn a 1 on a {@dice d20} into a 2.

feat.name: Quick Draw
entries: You draw two weapons at once.

feat.name: Quick Draw
entries: You draw a weapon faster than anyone.
